svg.text: MV0-C01 arm adapter — controlled candidate drawing
HR-V0-ARM-ARCH-P0.6 — PRELIMINARY - CANDIDATE GEOMETRY ONLY - NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION
2× Ø5.50 +0.10/−0.00 at X=0, Z=±10.00; center coordinates ±0.05
2× countersink Ø11.30 +0.10/−0.00, 90° included nominal; received screw functional gauge controls
Material and process
6061‑T651 plate, ASTM B209 / AMS 4027, OnlineMetals part 1249 candidate.
One 8×8×3/8 in sheet, one heat lot, MTR required. CNC mill/drill only.
Finished thickness 9.00–10.00 mm; opposite broad faces parallel within 0.10 mm.
Flatness ≤0.15 mm over the finished part. Bare as-machined; remove all burrs.
Break sharp edges 0.20–0.50 mm. No anodize, plating, or unapproved substitution.
Functional acceptance
Use received Accu SHKL-M5-20-A2-R360 as the countersink functional gauge.
Head proud ≤0.05 mm; recess ≤0.25 mm. Residual thickness below cone ≥5.80 mm.
Inspect all dimensions; record actual hole coordinates, thickness, flatness, and mass.
Dry-fit only with received ROBOTIS frames and 20-2040 article before load proof.
Release boundary
Drawing is suitable for supplier DFM/quotation only after program authorization.
No production quantity. One separately authorized first article maximum.
Torque, final locking validation, cable clearance, proof load, FAI, and qualified
mechanical disposition remain required before assembly or actuator connection.
DO NOT FABRICATE OR ENERGIZE FROM THIS DRAWING ALONE.
Units: mm • Projection: adapter face X–Z • Revision: HR-V0-ARM-ARCH-P0.6
